description: Verify final delivery preconditions: all required artifacts reachable, all prior gates have gate_attempt(passed=true) in trace, profile YAML and trace JSONL parseable, status values point to readiness→none.

rules.failure_message: seed_topics/ directory is missing or empty. Seed topic materialization must have completed before readiness.
Missing file: reference/index.md. Wave0 evidence indexing must have completed before readiness.
Missing file: artifacts/wave2/synthesis.md. Wave2 cross-topic synthesis must have completed before readiness.
Missing file: artifacts/hitl2/decision-brief.md. HITL2 final review must have completed before readiness.
Not all prior gates have a gate_attempt(passed=true) in rb_trace.jsonl. Each non-terminal gate before readiness must have passed at least once. Check inspect output for the specific missing gate(s).
rb_profile.yaml is missing or contains invalid YAML. Fix YAML syntax errors.
rb_trace.jsonl is missing or contains unparseable lines. Every line in rb_trace.jsonl must be valid JSON. Remove or fix any non-JSON lines.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'readiness_passed'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct gate value.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'none' (final is a terminal node with no outgoing gate). Status may have drifted — restore the correct value.
